title: Products of Brown localizations
statement:
Use quasicategories, nerves and coherent functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in universes enlarged to contain all categories and mapping spaces in question. Let $J$ be any small set. For each $j\in J$ let $\mathcal A_j$ be an ordinary category with initial object $0_j$ and classes $C_j,W_j$ containing isomorphisms and closed under composition. Assume $W_j$ has two-out-of-three and is retract closed, every $0_j\to X$ belongs to $C_j$, every arrow factors as a member of $C_j$ followed by a member of $W_j$, pushouts of members of $C_j$ exist and belong to $C_j$, and pushouts of members of $C_j\cap W_j$ belong to $C_j\cap W_j$. Write $q_j:N(\mathcal A_j)\to L_j$ for a homotopy coherent localization, meaning that restriction into any quasicategory identifies the whole functor category out of $L_j$ with the full subcategory inverting $W_j$. Then the functor
$$N(\prod_{j\in J}\mathcal A_j)=\prod_{j\in J}N(\mathcal A_j)\xrightarrow{\prod_jq_j}\prod_{j\in J}L_j$$
is a homotopy coherent localization at the class of coordinatewise weak equivalences. Thus its restriction functor has that same entire-functor-category universal property. The empty product is included. No coproducts in the categories $\mathcal A_j$, no model structures and no finiteness of $J$ are assumed.
